correctness.rationale: The random partition matrix is A=a I-kappa*h*c P_B, where P_B is a rank N-N/p orthoprojector and E[P_B]=(m/c)(I-J). Hence E[A^2]=a^2 J+rho(I-J) and rho=1-2(alpha+kappa m)h+D h^2; the mean-square boundary rho<1 gives exactly h<h_max and the covariance uJ+v(I-J). At h*=2/(2alpha+kappa c), b=-a, so every A is a scalar orthogonal reflection and the conditional stationary Gaussian covariance is deterministic uI. Away from h*, conditioning on the latest partition gives a random contrast variance with pair-cobatching probability (p-1)/(N-1) and Var(||Pw||^2)=4(p-1)(N-p)/(p^2(N-1)^2); conditional Gaussian-mixture Jensen yields the stated strictly positive lower bound. This is valid also if the fourth moment diverges (extended excess). The stationary perpetuity and finite-second-moment uniqueness follow from L2 contraction. Independently enumerated all exact rational equipartitions for (N,p)=(4,2),(6,2),(6,3),(8,2),(8,4), checking projector mean and contrast variance; finite checks do not establish unrestricted N,p.
